'''Dole Happ''' was a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Force Adept]], who lived during the waning years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
In [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]], Happ attended the [[SoroSuub Anniversary celebration, 31 BBY|SoroSuub Anniversary celebration]] that was held in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Tolea Biqua]], on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Genarius]]. During the event, Happ served as an [[Agent/Legends|agent]] of the Force Adept [[Taleah Novran]], who was trying to pair young Force Adepts with suitable mentors.

==Personality and traits==
Raadun was very lighthearted and found it difficult to take things seriously. He was curious and adventurous and enjoyed going to parties, going on adventures and getting into trouble.
